items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: Especially when they got Alvin Burroughs. Yes. Yes, well Earl was, Earl was a Western band... Earl had a good band.

ctx.x: Yes, but now, Jonah Jones said to me once that they always thought of Earl Hines as a Western band.
You see, those bands of his had the same sort of, somewhat similar feeling.
